falsifier: Stop FIR if this exact no-control reference is insolvent or incomplete; has nonpositive annualized return, net Sharpe, doubled-cost Sharpe, or aggregate realized funding PnL; exceeds 0.30 drawdown; has fewer than four profitable folds; has nonpositive bull, bear, or chop return; or fails long-bull or short-bear attribution. Risk controls cannot rescue a failed reference.
thesis: Realized funding dispersion is a direct causal carry spread: hold low-funding inventory long and high-funding inventory short, favoring rates already relaxing toward normalization, while a fixed high-volatility exclusion and modest equal side budgets limit squeeze exposure across bull, bear, and chop.
